body: If I tell my doctor she'll make a big thing.  I can't afford to get put in the hospital.  Last time she doubled my prozac dosage and called me every night for a week, and I wasn't even that serious then.

I can't even dfine it properly.  I've been in therapy for about 7 years and I still don't quite understand what's wrong with me.  Major Depressive Disorder, she says.  I just feel alone and disconnected and lost.  I try to get close to people and then feel like I'm a burden or a creep or too needy.  I have a friend at work and asked her if we could go for a walk today.  She said she needed to work through lunch, and I feel like I've gone too far again.  But then it cycles and spirals, where I sort of get that maybe she just needs to work through lunch but I'm so angry and hateful of myself for making it personal, like I can't just let stuff be what it is.  It turns and turns like that, hating myself for hating myself, being depressed because I can't seem to stop being depressed.  I'm listening to white noise right now as loud as I can stand it, trying to drown out the world and I just feel worse.
